metadataReview.coordinateBasis: The rejected point [128.83,35.03] is the P625 locator of island Q12612282. The institutional narratives locate the fighting near Gadeokdo without a surveyed position or a calibrated battle map. Remove coordinates; do not substitute the island centre, fortress or later memorial.

inclusionReview.note: The item is individually included as the Gadeokdo naval engagement of 1597 identified by its Academy of Korean Studies reference E0000076: Won Gyun’s Joseon force fought Japanese naval forces near Gadeokdo after the Angolpo encounter. It is distinct from the later seventh-month operations and the battle of Chilcheollyang already catalogued as Q483088. The source item’s 1957-07-14 is rejected by the companion metadata review. The institution gives the traditional sixth month, nineteenth day; only the independently established year 1597 is published until conversion to the atlas calendar is verified. The island locator is explicitly withdrawn; no fleet totals or loss counts are inferred.
